meta.title: BBA in Marketing | Atlas ISME Mumbai
meta.description: Build a brand-driven career at Atlas ISME, Mumbai. Study BBA in marketing covering bba marketing course details in digital branding and advertising.

panes.label: Overview
panes.text:
The BBA / BBA (Hons) in Marketing at ATLAS ISME is designed to develop creative, strategic and data-literate marketers who can shape brands and drive growth in a dynamic global marketplace. The program builds strong foundations in consumer psychology, digital strategy, brand management and marketing analytics.

Learning is immersive, delivered through live projects, brand simulations, marketing labs and masterclasses with industry leaders. Each concept, from consumer insight to digital transformation, is examined through real business challenges. By the end of the program, you will be prepared to create compelling campaigns, lead market strategies and build brands that inspire across industries, start-ups or your own entrepreneurial venture.

cards.title: Understand markets and consumers to influence business outcomes
Build impactful brands across industries and platforms
Use data and tools to drive high-performing campaigns
Turn insights into a strategy that delivers results
Create brand stories that attract and retain customers
Leverage emerging technologies to optimise user experiences and engagement
Finance
cards.text: Master key financial concepts, including investment, valuation, and budgeting, to drive organisational growth. The Finance minor prepares you for careers in corporate finance, banking and investment management.

cards.title: Family Managed Business
cards.text: Develop expertise in governance, succession, strategy, finance and leadership within family enterprises. Prepare to lead, professionalise and sustain multi-generational businesses in an evolving global business environment.

cards.title: Business Analytics
cards.text: Harness data to drive smarter business decisions. Learn to analyse trends, visualise information and use quantitative tools to impact marketing, finance, and strategy with data-driven insights.

cards.title: Entrepreneurship
cards.text: Transform ideas into action by learning to launch ventures and drive innovation. This minor sharpens your creativity, leadership and problem-solving through real-world projects and collaboration.

cards.title: Economics
cards.text: Explore the economic forces and policies shaping global businesses and markets. Learn how economic analysis informs decision-making and drives innovation through public policy.

cards.title: AI & Emerging Technologies
cards.text: Understand how AI, machine learning and emerging technologies are reshaping industries and driving innovation, efficiency and growth.

cards.title: Digital Branding & Advertising
cards.text: Master digital marketing strategies, create compelling brand identities, and design effective campaigns to engage and grow online audiences.

cards.title: Business Psychology
cards.text: Explore how psychological principles influence workplace behaviour, leadership, decision-making and team dynamics to optimise performance and culture.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: This course set covers core management, marketing, finance, and entrepreneurship, integrating AI, Excel and design thinking, with insights into consumer behaviour and Indian psychology for effective decision-making.

courses.text: Learn the core management functions of planning, organising, leading and controlling to effectively manage teams and organisations.
Understand key marketing strategies and how consumer psychology influences purchasing decisions to create impactful campaigns.
Explore behavioural patterns, cultural influences and psychological principles that shape individual and collective decision-making.

title.strong: AI Tools & Excel for Decision Making

courses.text: Build practical spreadsheet and AI-based skills to analyse data, create models and generate meaningful insights.
Gain insights into starting and managing ventures, develop strong business models and build an entrepreneurial mindset.

title.strong: Basics of Finance / Design Thinking for Business

courses.text: Understand essential financial concepts for business decisions, or use design thinking to innovate and creatively solve business challenges.
Expands learning with interdisciplinary exposure that supports analytical and managerial growth. Select from 50+ Electives.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: This set covers digital marketing, finance, innovation, economics, communication and India’s constitutional framework for navigating modern business effectively.

courses.text: Explore how digital transformation, sustainability and innovation are reshaping traditional business frameworks for the future economy.
Learn strategies to build and grow brands online using SEO, social media, analytics and content-driven marketing.
Develop strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively express ideas and collaborate in professional settings.
Gain a foundational understanding of market dynamics, economic policies and their impact on global and local business environments.

title.strong: Financial Statement Analysis / Systems Thinking for Innovation

courses.text: Learn to interpret financial data for strategic decision-making or use systems thinking to create innovative and connected business solutions.

title.strong: Statistics for Business / Creative Thinking & Problem Solving

courses.text: Master data interpretation for business insights or strengthen creative reasoning to tackle complex challenges with innovative solutions.
Gain real-world experience by applying classroom concepts in a professional setting. Build skills, confidence and industry exposure. Select from 50+ Electives.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: This semester strengthens marketing execution and financial compliance capabilities, integrating analytical SEO strategy, managerial accounting and taxation to support operational business decisions.

courses.text: Understand how people behave in organisations and learn HR practices to manage and motivate teams effectively.

Build persuasive communication and client management skills through live simulations and market-based negotiation challenges. Students learn how to convert consumer insights into effective sales strategies.
Master the tools and analytics of digital visibility. Students design and monitor live campaigns, learning how SEO and SEM drive brand positioning and measurable marketing ROI.
Introduces costing methods, budgeting and managerial reporting to support operational decisions.
Provides practical understanding of direct and indirect tax principles, compliance and basic tax planning.
Choose a course that matches your interests and expands your knowledge.

title.strong: Applied Component: Internship / Applied Project Report

courses.text: Gain hands-on experience by applying classroom learning in a real-world setting and building practical skills.

semesters.title: Semester 4
semesters.text: This course set blends strategic marketing, corporate finance, and ethical communication with analytical tools that enhance decision-making, digital engagement, and risk management in modern business environments.

courses.text: Learn the legal rules and regulations that guide business operations and protect organisations.
Understand how businesses are managed responsibly and the ethical principles that guide decision-making.
Explores digital storytelling, campaign strategy and audience engagement through analytics-based tools.
Introduces quantitative marketing techniques for campaign optimisation, consumer insight and ROI assessment.
Explains financial derivatives and hedging mechanisms to manage market risk in business contexts.
Focuses on capital budgeting, valuation and financing decisions driving corporate growth.
Choose a course that matches your interests and broadens your knowledge.

title.strong: Applied Component: Internship / Applied Project Report

courses.text: Gain practical experience by applying classroom learning in real-world situations and developing professional skills.

semesters.title: Semester 5
semesters.text: This course set blends advanced marketing strategy with financial innovation and AI-driven tools, empowering students to build brands, analyze markets, and craft data-backed narratives for global business impact.

courses.text: Learn how to plan, make decisions and lead organisations to achieve long-term business goals.
Understand global markets, cross-cultural business practices and how international perspectives shape business strategies.
Explores strategies for creating, positioning and sustaining strong brands across competitive markets.
Focuses on digital campaign design, automation and performance tracking using real-time analytics tools.
Introduces financial structuring, valuation and advisory processes in capital markets and mergers.
Covers digital finance innovations, including blockchain, digital payments and financial data systems.
Choose a course that matches your interests and broadens your knowledge.

title.strong: Applied Component: Internship / Applied Project Report

courses.text: Gain practical experience by applying classroom learning in real-world situations and developing professional skills.

semesters.title: Semester 6
semesters.text: This course set integrates strategic, financial, and global business knowledge with emerging technology insights and ethical considerations in AI.

courses.text: Learn how timeless philosophical ideas can guide decision-making and leadership in today’s business world.
Develop skills to present data clearly using charts, graphs and other visual tools for better insights.
Examines retail ecosystems and digital consumer behaviour. Focuses on technology-driven retail strategy.
Covers media planning, campaign creation and reputation management. Builds persuasive communication and brand storytelling skills.
Explores how emotions and biases shape financial decisions. Applies psychology to explain real-world market behaviour.
Introduces ESG frameworks and ethical investment principles. Links sustainability to long-term financial performance.
Choose a course that matches your interests and broadens your knowledge.

title.strong: Applied Component: Internship / Applied Project Report

courses.text: Gain practical experience by applying classroom learning in real-world situations and developing professional skills.

semesters.title: Semester 7
semesters.text: This course set equips students with a global business and marketing perspective, investment expertise, and practical skills in big data analysis.

courses.text: Covers the coordination of advertising, PR and digital media, enabling students to design unified brand messages and maintain audience engagement across platforms.
Explores ethical standards and legal frameworks in marketing, enabling students to create responsible campaigns and ensure regulatory compliance.
Introduces market structures and chart indicators, enabling students to interpret price movements and make informed trading decisions.

semesters.title: Semester 8
semesters.text: This course set strengthens analytical, visualization, and design-thinking capabilities while integrating AI-driven innovation. The research dissertation allows students to apply these skills to real-world business problems, fostering critical thinking.

courses.text: Introduces research methods and analytical tools, allowing students to generate insights and support informed marketing decisions.
Explores data-driven financial modelling and performance analysis, equipping students to derive insights and support strategic decision-making.
